list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this bounty opened (frozen 2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description plus general GTA knowledge. Where a specific place or step is not pinned down by the official description, the guide says so instead of inventing a verified location.
sources: Official trophy list: Exophase — exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/ (names, descriptions, grades)
Guide text: our own reading of the official descriptions; not copied from any other guide

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide (story first, then side strands, activities, collectibles, and money clean-up last) and this is the final trophy you will hear. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up (1 platinum of 55). Missable: no — it cannot be missed, it unlocks when everything else is done.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story mission of the game. Just follow the on-screen objectives; story missions cannot be failed permanently, so if you fail a section, retry it from the checkpoint and keep going. This is the natural first trophy of any playthrough. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (mission name in the description); our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — story missions can be replayed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock when the chapter's final mission completes, so there is no side task to hunt — keep following the story. If you are unsure how far along you are, the in-game mission log / story progress screen shows which chapter you are in. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies, this one is purely story progress — no collectible, activity or side strand is needed for it. Keep following the main missions and it unlocks at the chapter's close. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 3 to its end. This is the halfway-ish story beat the trophy name celebrates — the chapter's final mission is what triggers it, so push the main story forward whenever it is available. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 4 to its end — the last chapter before the finale. Finish its closing mission and the trophy pops. If you have been doing side content along the way, this is a good moment to check your side-strand progress before the final mission, since the endgame is close. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is one of only two gold trophies, and it is pure story completion — no extra objective is named in the official description. Before you start the finale, consider saving first and clearing any side strands you care about, because after the credits the game returns you to free roam for clean-up. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the grade; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — the final mission can be retried and replayed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one unlock their trophy on completion, whatever your performance in the mission — follow the objectives, use checkpoints after a failure, and finish it. The mission's exact place in the story is not pinned down by the official description, so play the story in order and it will come. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in GTA games usually have a set-up chain first — finish any set-up missions the story offers, then the heist itself, and the trophy unlocks when the heist mission ends. Bring your best weapons and armour into it; a failed attempt just restarts from a checkpoint. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. As with the other named-mission trophies, finishing the mission is the whole requirement — no medal, no optional objective and no time limit are named in the official description. Keep playing the story in order and it will arrive. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy name (DWNFALL) hints at a dramatic story beat, but the official description names only the mission — finish it and the trophy is yours. If the mission has a tricky section, retry from the checkpoint rather than restarting the whole mission. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. The name suggests a vehicle or aircraft theft as the mission's centrepiece — follow the mission markers and take the target vehicle when the game tells you to. A failed attempt restarts at a checkpoint, so the trophy cannot be locked out. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The operation-style name suggests a large set-piece mission — stock up on ammo and armour before starting, follow the objectives, and use checkpoints if a section goes wrong. It unlocks on mission completion alone. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist — the second gold trophy, and the real long haul behind the platinum. In GTA games 100% means the story plus a fixed set of side missions, activities, collectibles and stunts, tracked on the game's stats/progress screen; open that screen early so you can see exactly which categories still count. Do the story first, then work the categories in this guide's roadmap one by one — most of the 55 trophies feed directly into the 100% total. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the grade; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — everything that counts toward 100% can be done after the story in free roam, as far as the official description shows.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, air time, drifts and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. The fastest honest way is to drive fast and recklessly on purpose: use ramps, jumps and long straight roads, and chain stunt moments in a fast car or bike. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every stunt you do while travelling counts — you will likely be well on the way by the end of the story. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 250 target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once — you do not need to win, master or finish any of them, just sample all nine. The activity types are the game's side pastimes (racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone racing, bowling, meditation and similar — the exact nine are listed on the game's activities/progress screen, which is the reliable place to check which ones you have tried). Open that screen, note the untried ones, and do one of each. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 9-activity target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range (marked on the map / activities menu), pick a challenge, and aim for the gold score or time shown on its results screen. Work through the weapon types one at a time and repeat a challenge freely — failed attempts cost nothing but time, and you can retry a challenge as often as you like. Prioritise accuracy over speed where the scoring rewards hits. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 42-challenge target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find a drone-race start (Top Fun branding on the map / activities list), learn each course's line with a practice run if the game offers one, then race to win — only a win at a location ticks it off. Keep a note of which locations you have won; the 14 are spread across Leonida, so expect to travel. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 14-location target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — races can be retried.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one. Enter races from the map / race menu across Leonida, vary the race types and locations, and keep winning new ones. Use the fastest car you own for the class, learn the braking points on a first lap, and remember a win only counts if the race is one you have not won before. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 20-race target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest against the character Cal. Go fishing where the game offers a challenge against Cal (fishing spots / the fishing activity menu), then out-fish him: follow the reeling prompts carefully, keep the line tension in the safe zone, and land the bigger catch. If you lose, challenge him again — a lost contest is not a locked-out trophy. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete (finish) one arcade game — play an arcade cabinet through to its end, or to a completion screen. Find an arcade machine in the world (arcades / bars with machines), pick any game, and play it out; you do not need a high score, just a completed run. If a game is long, pick the shortest cabinet you can find. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — the end of Andy's side-strand mission chain. Side characters like Andy hand out missions as you progress the story; keep checking for Andy's icon / contact after story beats and play each mission he offers in order until the strand closes. The official description names only the final mission, so the strand itself is the path. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — side strands stay available after the story, as far as the official description shows.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission — the end of Kenton's side-strand chain. Play Kenton's missions as they appear during and after the story, in order, until his last one is done. The boat-accident name hints at a water-based finale, so expect boats or a marina setting, but the official description does not confirm the location — follow Kenton's mission markers, not a guess. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission — the end of Billy's side-strand chain. The 'lone rider' name suggests a bike or solo-ride finale; play Billy's missions as they unlock and finish the last one. Do not rush past side-character contacts while playing the story — missing a strand's start only delays it, it does not lock it. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers — the classic GTA Strangers & Freaks side content. Roam Leonida and watch for stranger markers (usually a '?' or a named character icon), take their missions, and finish each strand to its end; a strand counts only when its final mission is done. Eight strands is a lot, so start them early and clear one or two between story chapters rather than leaving all eight for after the credits. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 8-strand target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission — the end of Randy's side-strand chain. Play Randy's missions as they appear and finish the last one; the supply-and-demand name suggests deliveries or deals, but the official description does not pin down the mission's content, so follow the strand's markers. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission — the end of Tyrone's side-strand chain. Play Tyrone's missions in order as they unlock; the trophy lands on the strand's closing mission. If a strand seems to stall, advance the story a mission or two — side characters often offer their next mission only after a story beat. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Find a spot (the game marks meditation locations on the map / activities list once discovered), sit and complete the meditation prompt there. The spots are spread across the whole state, so this pairs naturally with exploration — tick them off as you travel for other trophies, and keep a note of which of the 18 you have done. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 18-spot target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a special hunting target tied to the character Bret. Take Bret's hunting strand, follow his directions to the animal's area, and hunt it (a scoped rifle and patience help; the animal is unique, so the game should mark or hint at its territory). The exact species and location are not pinned down by the official description — follow Bret's missions rather than hunting at random. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets — find every card in three sets (cards are hidden around Leonida: in shops, on shelves, in interiors and out in the world). Pick up every card you spot while exploring, and use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are near-complete so you can hunt the missing cards deliberately. A set counts only when every card in it is collected. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 3-set target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — cards stay collectible in free roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations — WAiNK is the game's in-world photo/tagging activity, so visit 100 distinct spots and WAiNK at each. Spread it across your whole playthrough: WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new, and the count climbs without a dedicated grind. The game's WAiNK / activity screen should show your running total. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 100-location target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's challenge list (driving, combat, exploration and activity feats, shown on the challenges/progress screen). Open that screen, pick the easiest unfinished challenges first, and clear them in batches as you play; many will complete naturally while you chase other trophies. You need 50, not all of them, so skip any challenge that looks miserable. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 50-challenge target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape — all in one run, with your partner present. Plan it: bring your partner along (a story or free-roam moment where they ride with you), cause enough trouble in a quiet area to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears — alleys, tunnels and switching vehicles help. If your partner leaves or you get busted, set it up and try again; do it deliberately rather than hoping it happens by accident. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: YES — it needs a specific set-up (partner present + 4 stars + a clean escape in one attempt), so flag it and do it on purpose; it can be retried in free roam, but it will not happen by accident.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the heat drops between robberies, so you must keep the wanted level alive across all three. Scout three shops close together first, bring your partner, rob the first, move fast to the next while the cops are still on you, and repeat a third time. If the wanted level clears, the chain resets and you start over. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: YES — one unbroken chain of three, with the wanted level kept alive throughout; plan the route before the first robbery.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or enter 100 distinct vehicle models. The count is cumulative: every new car, bike, truck or boat you get into adds to it, so vary what you drive instead of sticking to one favourite. The game's vehicle / collection screen shows how many you have found. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 100-vehicle target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Set it up deliberately: find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends — a weapon with a fast fire rate helps, and you want enemies close together rather than spread out. If you only get four, the attempt fails and you try again; the trophy is about one clean use, not a lifetime total. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: YES in the one-attempt sense — it must be 5 in a single Combat Focus; retry the set-up until it lands.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave Vice City International Airport in a way the game counts as unscheduled (the description's wording suggests stealing or commandeering a plane, or otherwise departing without going through the normal route). Go to VCIA, find an aircraft or a runway exit, and leave the airport by that unofficial route. The official description does not spell out the exact method, so treat this as a try-it-and-see trophy at the airport rather than a fixed walkthrough step — attempt it in free roam, where a failed try costs nothing. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: YES — it is tied to one specific place and one specific kind of departure, so do it deliberately at VCIA.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the official description is a joke line, not an instruction, so the honest guide is: this trophy involves the Rhino tank (steal one, survive one, or take one on — the exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description). The practical approach is to get a wanted level high enough that Rhinos are sent after you, then interact with a Rhino (hijack it if the game lets you) and see the trophy pop; if the trigger is a specific action, the in-game hint when a Rhino appears should clarify it. Do not trust any walkthrough that claims a precise method without a source. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: FLAGGED — the trigger is a specific tank encounter, so attempt it deliberately when Rhinos show up rather than assuming it will happen.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean stealth robbery. Scout the store first: learn the guard / camera pattern, go in quiet, take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are detected, the attempt fails — leave, let things cool down, and try again. The official description names no specific store, so use any jewelry store the game lets you rob; a store with few staff is the easiest first try. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: YES — one clean undetected run; a detected attempt does not count, so retry until it is clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — five separate successful vault robberies. Plan each one: pick a bank, get in, crack or breach the vault, grab the cash and escape the wanted level that follows. Escaping matters — a robbery where you get caught does not count. Five escapes is a grind, so spread them out and use a fast getaway car parked nearby. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 5-vault target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — vaults can be robbed again after the story.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — spot one on the road, stop it (block it, shoot its tires, or force the driver out), crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. Keep a fast car ready for the getaway. If the truck gets away or you get busted, find another truck and try again — they keep spawning. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — visit every named district/area on the map. The map / exploration screen tracks which areas you have visited; open it, note the unvisited ones, and drive through each. This pairs perfectly with the collectibles and meditation spots, since visiting everywhere is how you find them. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 52-area target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one hit per gang. Gang operations are marked or discoverable in gang territory; hit one operation for each of the nine gangs and escape each time. Keep a checklist of which gangs you have hit — the game's gangs/operations screen should show it — and work through the remaining gangs one by one. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 9-gang target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — go to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water and order/have a cocktail there. The trophy is a quiet moment trophy, so take it slowly: walk the Ocean Beach strip, find a bar with outdoor seating facing the sea, and use the drink interaction. The official description does not name the exact bar, so any beachfront bar with a view is the honest first try — if the first one does not trigger it, try the next bar along the strip. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: FLAGGED — it is one specific moment at one specific beach, so do it deliberately while you are near Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front window, the classic GTA opening-style exit. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or line one up outside, and drive out through the glass. The official description does not name which showroom, so any vehicle showroom is the honest first try. One dramatic exit is all it takes; if it does not pop, try another showroom. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: FLAGGED — one specific stunt at one specific kind of place, so do it on purpose.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow through on a bowl there (the description's 'follow-through' suggests completing a bowling game or a full throw). Go to the named alley, start a game of bowling and play it through. You do not need a strike or a win as far as the official description shows — just bowl at that alley. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — the alley stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — the official description is deliberately vague, so the honest guide is: this is tied to your partnership (the two protagonists working together) reaching some public or crowd-pleasing milestone. Play the partner missions and shared activities; the trigger is likely a specific partner activity or story beat, and the game should signpost it when it happens. Do not trust a walkthrough that names a precise method without citing a source — this guide will be updated when the trigger is verified. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — as far as the official description shows, it is a story/partner beat, not a one-shot moment.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy, so it is about the cumulative choices you make across the game (dialogue picks, approach choices, partner decisions). Just play naturally and choose when the game asks; the counter climbs over a full playthrough, and the trophy pops when the count is reached. There is no single 'right' choice to hunt — volume of decisions is what matters. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 500-choice target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description ('second time's the charm') means this pops when you fail something and then succeed at the very next attempt. The practical approach: attempt something you can fail and retry immediately (a mission, a challenge or an activity), fail once, then succeed on the retry — the trophy should pop on that second-attempt success. The exact activity is not pinned down by the official description, so try it on a retryable mission or challenge you know well. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: FLAGGED — it needs a fail-then-succeed pair in sequence, so set it up deliberately.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description reads like a UFO / paranormal / easter-egg moment, so this trophy is about stumbling on one of Leonida's weird events. Explore the odd corners of the map (remote areas, late at night, places that feel out of place) and the moment should find you; easter-egg trophies like this usually trigger on seeing the event, not on fighting or collecting anything. The exact event is not pinned down by the official description — this guide will name it only once a sourced report confirms it. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no — easter-egg spots can be revisited.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl the target over. Find a pedestrian in a quiet area, drive past slowly, and swing the melee weapon from the car window as you pass. It takes timing: too fast and you miss, too slow and you stop being a drive-by. If it does not pop, try again on the next passer-by — it is a single clean hit, not a cumulative count. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: YES — one specific hit in one specific way; do it deliberately.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — Marked Bills are the dirty cash you pick up from robberies and heists, and your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep robbing (vaults, trucks, operations) to collect Marked Bills, then launder them through contacts whenever you have a stack — the $250,000 is cumulative earnings, not a single laundering. This is a late-game clean-up trophy: it finishes itself if you keep robbing while chasing the other money trophies. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the $250,000 target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative spending on clothes, weapons, cars, food and anything else shops sell. You will spend a lot of this naturally on guns, ammo and vehicles; if you are short near the end, buy the most expensive items you still want (a pricey car or high-end weapon) to close the gap. Check the stats screen for your lifetime spending total. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the $100,000 target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — buy every garage the game offers, so you have storage across Leonida. Garages are bought from the in-game property / real-estate menu or by visiting their signs; save up (this pairs with the spending and laundering trophies) and buy them one by one. The property screen should show how many of the 8 you own. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 8-garage target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery/rideshare app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone, register vehicles you own or find (10 different ones), and the trophy pops. Use the varied vehicles you already discovered for Whip It Good — registering them here double-counts your exploration. Sources: official trophy list on Exophase; PSNProfiles for the 10-vehicle target; our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game. Missable: no.
